exposure: Breastfeeding within the first hour of life
Guidance on maternal benefits of breastfeeding
outcome: Prevalence of breastfeeding beyond 12 months of age
Continuation of breastfeeding beyond 12 months of age
cohort: The study included 403 Brazilian mothers with children aged 12-24 months who completed an online questionnaire.
finding: Over 70% of mothers surveyed were breastfeeding beyond 12 months, with key influencing factors for continuation being knowledge of benefits, personal desire, attending more than six prenatal visits, awareness of WHO recommendations, and receiving guidance on maternal breastfeeding benefits and milk expression/storage.
cross-section timing: September to December 2024, with children aged 12-24 months at the time of the survey
